r13: Sentinel freeze and protect (R13): containment of a passkey QED has suspended; see README "R13: containing a suspended passkey".
r13OwnerOptions: Guardian (co-signed recoveries, set behind the delay), optional time-lock of withdraw/ringFence/unpause/setGuardian, WebAuthn checks in the account (differential test against OpenZeppelin's WebAuthn.verify); see README "R13: owner options". Evidence: evidence/r13-owner/ (scripts/run-evidence.sh).
r13ReviewFixes: Review fixes of 25 Nov 2026 (F1 to F5): a co-signed recovery finishes only after a whole recoveryDelay with a Member unfrozen (none unfrozen: it waits; a thaw restarts it in full); the guardian can withdraw its co-signature; recovery deadlines at most one day ahead; a removal leaves more than adminThreshold settled Members it does not name; stale time-lock, sentinel and guardian changes never apply; a recovery started without the guardian does not finish while one is set. See README "R13 review fixes". Evidence: evidence/r13-secfix/.
r13H1: Independent review H1 (25 Nov 2026): with every Member frozen, the sentinel (QED) may stop a pending co-signed recovery (stopRecovery), and such a recovery finishes after its whole delay only if that sentinel was set and unchanged throughout (else NoUnfrozenMember); a restart is never earlier (L1). See README "R13 H1". Evidence: evidence/r13-h1/.
